label: build S5 2/2
result:
S5 unit 2 is built on v2/s5. The headless walk found no console errors at 1280 or 390, for a new learner and a seeded one, with one exception: the Mark button hits an endpoint that isn't merged yet (below). The branch was rebased onto master first; master had one new commit, which only changed `spec/v2-state/RESUME.md`. All work is committed, the server is stopped, and HEAD is detached so the branch is free.

**What I built**
- **The paper sheet** (`web/tests/talk.js`, new):
  - **Gated state:** until you have finished the paper, you only see the post count and "Start Paper #N".
  - **Questions tab:** says where the data comes from and shows "Traps of this paper" and "Your cheapest points". It has Sort (6 orders), Module and Source filters, and a "Not on your route" group. Each row shows % right, n, median time, top trap or designed traps, posts, and a Right/Missed/Blank mark. Expanding a row shows the spread plus Try one like this, Discuss and Open my review.
  - **Discussion tab:** Top/Newest, an About filter, Helpful, Reply (one level, "Show N more replies"), Report, and Edit/Delete for 15 minutes. It asks for a board name when you have none, and the composer keeps your text if a send fails.
- **Compare two sittings** (`web/tests/compare.js`, new): a checkbox on each finished row (`X` on the focused row) and a sticky "Compare #a and #b" bar. `?compare=a,b` opens it directly. The sheet shows the two sittings' facts side by side (rows that are empty on both sides are hidden), then the slot-by-slot or by-type comparison from S6's endpoint.
- **Tests page** (`tests.js`, `index.html`):
  - The share sheet has "How: a link or a race by invite code". If Compete refuses the race, it falls back to `/compete/?create=`.
  - How you take tests has Last 5 / 10 / All and Sections and papers / All timed filters, plus "Which sittings?" and a trend line.
  - The cycle card shows a "Proved N of M" line once the server sends that data.
  - Each card has its own error and Retry. Habits get a loading skeleton. `J`/`K` also move through In progress rows.
  - Filter chips show only on phones (see decisions).
- **Start sheet:** the Trap test has a "Pick" option, a checklist of your open traps from `/api/mistakes`.
- **Test window:**
  - The Route-up trainer's hand-in lists what cost the route, with Try a twin on each, Fix what cost the route, and Next module 1.
  - Mark for review also posts S10's flag.

**Checks**
- `server/checks/s5.py`: "ok S5 server checks".
- `test_flow.py`: stops at the known date-dependent `server/checks/s8.py` line 519 ("contest not found"). I didn't chase it.

**Decisions for you**
- **Filter chips:** tests.md X20 wants removable chips under the filter bars. On desktop that repeats what the dropdowns already show, which your decision 7 rules out, so the chips only appear on phones where the bar folds into "Filters · n".
- **Papers shown:** the shelf shows 9 papers before "Show all" instead of the spec's 6. The spec's check for a new learner expects all 7 launch papers listed, and 6 would fail it.

**Commits:** 8f84df1, 224e4d2, 223a48f, 63e4308, 622c6c1.

**Needed from other owners** (the pages already handle each of these and hide or fall back until it lands)
- **S5 server (helper):**
  - The paper questions endpoint (`/api/papers/{n}/crowd`) should return your sitting id and each slot's question id, so Try one like this works on module 2.
  - `GET /api/tests` should read `habits_last` and `habits_scope`, and each habit row should list its sitting ids.
  - The cycle needs a `proved {n, of, pts}` field.
  - The hand-in's gate data needs the positions you got right, to draw the trainer's 22-cell strip.
  - A paper card's "You" gets a midpoint, not a band, so it reads "250" instead of a range like "560–700".
  - The Custom test's "For me" difficulty needs server support. Its request model doesn't accept it, so I didn't add the control.
- **S6:** `/api/history` still returns the old row shape (no number, modules, miss chips or conditions), and the compare endpoint `GET /api/session/{a}/compare?with=` doesn't exist yet, so the question-by-question part of Compare shows an error with Retry.
- **S10:** the flag endpoint exists only on v2/s10-server. Until it merges, every Mark logs a 405 console error.
- **S8:** `POST /api/contests` should accept a sitting or paper to build the race from. A client helper for Compete's Create a private contest sheet (my placeholder name: `UI.createContest`) also doesn't exist yet.
- **Unowned:** `.gitignore` should cover `server/cache/`, which the server writes at runtime. I deleted my run's copy.
